headline: Renesas lists PMIC verification roles spanning AMS, DMS, RNM, UVM, correlation, and sign-off
fact: Renesas listed related PMIC verification roles for battery chargers, switching regulators, and analog power IP. The descriptions cover chip-level AMS and full-chip DMS, SystemVerilog RNM and Verilog-AMS models integrated with RTL and UVM, model correlation to specifications and schematics, coverage closure and sign-off, and support for correlation to silicon bench measurements.

sources.title: Senior Staff Mixed Signal Verification Engineer
sources.summary: Official Renesas requisition dated April 16, 2026, for PMIC AMS/DMS verification, RNM/VAMS modeling, coverage, sign-off, and schematic and bench correlation.

sources.title: Staff AMS Verification Engineer
sources.summary: Official Renesas requisition dated April 28, 2026, for reusable UVM/RNM PMIC verification from blocks through full-chip and silicon correlation.
